sentences.text: The documents do not state whether section 8.2 of the Retail Loan Policy complies with RBI’s penal charges rules, because section 8.2 itself is not provided.

For a Tier 3 UCB, the in-force rule says penal interest is not permitted, and penal charges are permitted only if they are reasonable and commensurate with the non-compliance of material terms and conditions of the loan contract and are not discriminatory within a particular loan / product category.
The earlier 2023 fair-lending penal-charges circulars are superseded or no longer in force on 2026-11-23, so the operative source here is the UCB Responsible Business Conduct Directions, 2025.

missing.searched: Retail Loan Policy section 8.2 on penal interest
